exclusionRule: Runs whose validity check failed (wrong presentation count, a panel not visible, outside the canvas or overlapping, extraction refused, or W3 without any observed manipulation commit) are excluded from aggregates and listed in invalidRuns. Nothing else is excluded.
aggregation: Per run: median/P95/P99 over the run's samples. Per scenario: median of the per-run values across repeats, with min, max and coefficient of variation (cv). null = not measured or unsupported, never zero.
